scope: Native menu source integration, isolated browser storage
checks: Original Help exposes all 38 topics, searches their text, and navigates back to the contextual topic.
Home → Snelspel → difficulty → Startinfo; selection only announces; replay confirmation preserves the existing save when cancelled.
Continuing an adventure previews its saved chapter and saved difficulty.
Opnieuw retains explicit overwrite confirmation and cancellation leaves the old save intact.
Exporteren downloads the selected inactive player’s complete JSON without switching players or replacing the active save.
Spelerlijst create/select/delete keeps the original profile and its saved adventure separate.
Highscores displays rows and Stoppen → Nee returns without changing saves.
Original home and unlocked level cards remain reachable at 800×600, portrait and landscape mobile sizes.
All added settings remain present; independent volume and graphics preferences save; key remapping validates duplicates, discards Cancel, and applies OK.
A fresh adventure starts the real Forest through the restored menu without an overwrite warning.
Remapped gameplay keys and untouched WASD work; touch controls stay visible and functional; Menu retains pause/save/load/settings and returns home.
Startinfo presents native chapter and input artwork, saved player/score/difficulty, and keyboard/gamepad/joystick variants.
Controller navigation can open/close Meer opties and reach restart without changing the saved adventure.
Key-settings Help opens the original contextual topic, cancels active key capture, and returns to the unchanged draft.
All eight original Startinfo Help links navigate to their intended topics and back.
Quickplay uses RCMN43, shows Snelspel on the original loading screen, then starts the selected level.
harnessCorrection: First run passed all saved-menu checks but attempted to open a hidden details summary. The new Geavanceerd button is the intended control. Corrected only the harness and completed only the unfinished fresh-menu/input phase.
limitations: Original menu voice routing was captured with a resolved playback stub during browser navigation; actual voice ordering is covered separately by focused MenuAudio tests.
Opening cinematic was explicitly stopped in the gameplay input fixture; this is not a full campaign playthrough.
No release builds generated and no personal browser save modified.

finalReview.runtimeChange: GamepadMenu includes summary controls so the new Startinfo Meer opties disclosure is reachable with a controller.
finalReview.initialHarnessIssue: An initial browser launch exceeded the Unix-domain socket path limit with an absolute TMPDIR. The harness now uses relative temp_work, as in earlier successful runs; no game source issue.
